title: Trans-well migration assay
protocol: Place 150 x 10^3 isolated human trophoblasts in the upper chamber of 8 micron Transwells on 100 μl of solid growth factor reduced Matrigel.
Place 100 x 10^3 different NK cell subsets in the lower chamber with Bio-MPM-1 medium supplemented with 5 U/ml IL-15 and 5% pen-strep and non-essential amino acids for five days.
Add neutralizing antibodies for chemokines to the lower chambers at a concentration of 5 μg/ml each when required.
Induce NK subset ability to induce HUVECs migration by placing NK derived supernatants or control media in the lower chamber of Transwell inserts with 6.5 μm pores.
Plate 5 x 10^4 HUVECs in the upper chamber and allow them to migrate for 4 hours at 37°C.
At the end of trophoblast or HUVEC migration assays, cleanse the filter side of the upper chamber with a cotton swab.
Stain the filter for one hour with crystal violet in 2% ethanol.
Rinse the stained filter in water.
Gently cut the filter from the chamber and count cells that have migrated through the filter pores from the underside of the filter.
Count the number of cells that migrated across the filters in 4 high-power fields per insert.
Average the values obtained from the high-power fields for each insert.
Perform three identical replicate experiments for each migration condition.
